purpose: Teach: 可動/一団/電通/テコ/使節/敷設/全貌/国内線

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 可動式パーティションで会議室を分けましょう
lines.en: Let's divide up the meeting rooms with movable partitions.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Slight forward lean in the voice. Snappy attack on the opening word. Delegating without a question mark — this is how we'll proceed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人を一団でオリエンします
lines.en: Got it. I'll orient the new hires as a group.
lines.style: Affirming and immediate. A quick nod in the voice. Smooth, capable tone. No hesitation — he's already picturing the logistics.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 電通とのキャンペーンを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the campaign with Dentsu planned out.
lines.style: Brisk authority. Clean attack on 'Let's.' Purposeful pacing. She's moving down a checklist with confidence, not seeking agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業にテコ入れの予算を確保します
lines.en: Yes. I'll secure the budget boost for sales.
lines.style: Clipped, professional. Slight vocal dip on 'yes' — acknowledging before pivoting to his action. Efficient and assured.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外使節への接待を計画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan the reception for the overseas delegation.
lines.style: Poised, composed. Steady pacing. Formal register sits lightly in her voice — this is important but she's handled it before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ネット敷設工事の業者を選定します
lines.en: Yes. I'll select the vendor for the network infrastructure work.
lines.style: Straightforward and capable. No fumbling. Each phrase lands evenly. He's working through the to-do list with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトの全貌を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure everyone's aligned on the full project scope.
lines.style: Measured authority. Deliberate pace on 'full project scope' — emphasizing the stakes. Clear-eyed, not rushed. She's ensuring comprehension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国内線優待制度を社員に案内します
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the domestic flight privileges information out to the staff.
lines.style: Closing note. A touch lighter than the previous lines — still professional, but with the ease of wrapping up. Warm without losing focus.
